caption: The two ends of a bracelet with a magnetic clasp are brought close on a table, and they jump together and hold.

sa.check: A bracelet lies on a table with its two ends apart.
The two ends are brought close together.
The ends jump together and join.
The bracelet has a clasp at its ends: it is the end pieces that meet.
The order is apart, brought close, jump together, hold.

pc.expect: The ends lie still until they are brought close; the jump happens only when the two clasp pieces are next to each other.
pc.fail: The ends creep toward each other before either is touched or moved; or the bracelet moves along the table with no hand on it; or the joined ends spring apart with nothing pulling on them.

pc.expect: Over the last small gap the clasp pieces snap into contact and stay pressed together; if the bracelet is lifted it hangs as a closed loop.
pc.fail: The ends stop with a gap between them and stay that way; or touch and then slide apart on the table; or the clasp opens as the bracelet is lifted with nothing pulling on it.

pc.expect: The jump is along the line joining the two clasp pieces, toward each other, and they meet face to face.
pc.fail: One end jumps away from the other; or an end darts sideways past its partner; or the ends slide toward and away from each other several times before joining.

pc.expect: The band bends as a chain or strap and lies on the table; the clasp pieces stay hard and keep their shape as they meet.
pc.fail: The band stands rigid off the table like a bar; or stretches like elastic as an end is drawn along; or a clasp piece flattens as it meets its partner.

pc.expect: One bracelet with two ends; the ends join by touching and remain two pieces; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The two ends merge into a single piece with no seam; or the bracelet splits into more pieces; or an end vanishes; or the fingers pass through the bracelet.

pc.expect: The bracelet's colour, its links and clasp shape and the table surface stay the same.
pc.fail: The bracelet changes colour; or the links change pattern; or the table surface changes.
